Only an exhausted search returns the default zero. mpCollEnd treats any zero result as no override.

facts.value: Initialization resets all four records to the available chain and clears active state. Creation rejects floor ID -1 and returns NULL when no available node exists. Positive lifetimes expire at zero; nonpositive lifetimes remain unchanged. Null removal is inert, active-head removal recycles, and matched non-head removal only unlinks. A non-active supplied node is prepended to the available chain, so an unlinked node can be restored by another explicit call or by initialization. Repeated removal of an already available head can make its next pointer reference itself.
